Container.Name: Plex-Meta-Manager
Container.Overview: Plex Meta Manager (fork) builds collections, playlists and metadata for Plex. This fork keeps a primary and a secondary Plex server in step: set plex for the primary server and plex_secondary for the secondary server in config.yml. Put config.yml in the config folder before starting the container.
Container.Requires: A config.yml in the config folder. Start from config/config.yml.template in the repository.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds config.yml, metadata files, the cache and logs.

Config.Name: Run Times
Config.Description: Comma-separated times of day to run, in HH:MM.

Config.Name: Run Immediately
Config.Description: True runs once at start-up and exits instead of waiting for the run times.

Config.Name: Libraries First
Config.Description: True runs library operations before collections.

Config.Name: Read Only Config
Config.Description: True stops Plex Meta Manager from rewriting config.yml.

Config.Name: No Countdown
Config.Description: True hides the countdown to the next run in the log.
